bio: Need lamb shanks from the Thursian Mountains? The finest grade Cambion beef? Medallions stolen from the Free Armada? You can get all this and more from Don Hammon, the greatest butcher (and fence) on Remnant! There are queues around Temple Market to sample his wares and offload stolen goods. Just don't ask who his meat supplier is. It's a trade secret.
